slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the timing of purchases within a month. Turn 4 asked whether capacity applies to end-of-month or beginning-of-month inventory, but that is about inventory measurement timing, not when purchases occur relative to sales.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month before sales, as implied by the inventory balance I_t = I_{t-1} + x_t − s_t and the end-of-month capacity constraint.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked or confirmed when purchases occur within the month; the READY_TO_MODEL summary silently adopts a monthly balance that assumes purchase timing.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without resolving the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions and resolved most modeling details, but it missed the P1 hidden slot on when purchases occur within the month and silently assumed a monthly inventory balance before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
